title: Basic Rules
commonInfo:
## Basic Rules Fundamentals

### Communication

- Code is a medium of communication between developers. Optimize for clarity over brevity.
- Use pervasive, unambiguous domain terminology (Ubiquitous Language).
- Document the "why" and "what" behind non-obvious design decisions, workarounds, or business logic.

### Consistency

- Follow established project conventions consistently, even if they differ from personal preference.
- Use automated formatting tools (Prettier) to eliminate debates over code style.
- Name variables, functions, and files following a predictable, project-wide scheme.

### Robustness

- Design systems to fail safely and predictably.
- Validate all inputs at system boundaries (API endpoints, UI forms).
- Implement global error boundaries to prevent catastrophic UI crashes and ensure graceful degradation.
